description: This Java class defines a command handler in the Fineract project responsible for posting interest to a savings account as of a specific date. It handles commands with entity 'SAVINGSACCOUNT' and action 'POSTINTERESTASONDATE' by invoking the corresponding service method.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountInterestAsOnDateCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component implementing a command handler for posting interest on a savings account as of a specific date.

methods.name: PostSavingsAccountInterestAsOnDateCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to post interest by delegating to the write platform service.
